/**
 * TEMPORARY recording spec. Copy to  e2e/specs/zz-record-<slug>.spec.ts , edit the "FLOW" section, run (see SKILL.md step 4), then DELETE it.
 * It drives the REAL app (web build, phone viewport, mock backend), records a CDP screencast, every tap position and named "marks".
 * Output: $VIDEO_WORK_DIR/live/f00000.jpg ... and live/live.json  (frames, taps, marks, viewport).
 *
 * The example flow below is "add a staff member"; replace it with the flow of your video. Rules that keep the video looking right:
 *  - Always tap through tap()/type()/pick() so the finger marker lands where the tap really happened (it waits for the element to stop moving).
 *  - Take a mark() for every moment config.json refers to (startMark / anchors[].mark / endMark).
 *  - Only use real labels/testIDs you have verified in the app; the narration must describe exactly what the screen shows.
 */
import * as fs from 'fs';

import { BRANCHES, DEPARTMENTS, expect, loginAs, test, visit } from '../support';

const WORK = process.env.VIDEO_WORK_DIR;
const OUT = `${WORK}/live`;

test('record the flow', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
  test.skip(testInfo.project.name !== 'phone', 'phone viewport only (390x844, 3x)');
  test.skip(!WORK, 'set VIDEO_WORK_DIR to the work folder');
  test.setTimeout(180_000);
  fs.rmSync(OUT, { recursive: true, force: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });

  // ── start state: log in as the role the video is for ('admin' | 'manager' | 'staff' | 'fieldStaff') and open the first screen
  await loginAs(page, 'admin');
  await visit(page, '/admin/home');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('admin-home')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('manage-add-staff')).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(1800); // entrance animations finished, so the first frame is calm

  // ── recorder (do not change)
  const frames: { f: string; ts: number }[] = [];
  const taps: { t: number; x: number; y: number }[] = [];
  const marks: Record<string, number> = {};
  const mark = (name: string) => void (marks[name] = Date.now() / 1000);

  const cdp = await page.context().newCDPSession(page);
  let n = 0;
  cdp.on('Page.screencastFrame', (fr: { data: string; sessionId: number; metadata: { timestamp?: number } }) => {
    const f = `f${String(n++).padStart(5, '0')}.jpg`;
    fs.writeFileSync(`${OUT}/${f}`, Buffer.from(fr.data, 'base64'));
    frames.push({ f, ts: fr.metadata.timestamp ?? Date.now() / 1000 });
    void cdp.send('Page.screencastFrameAck', { sessionId: fr.sessionId }).catch(() => undefined);
  });
  await cdp.send('Page.startScreencast', { format: 'jpeg', quality: 92, maxWidth: 1170, maxHeight: 2532, everyNthFrame: 1 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);

  // ── helpers (do not change). Tap position is read when the element has STOPPED moving: scrolls and sheet slide-ups shift it.
  const stableBox = async (loc: ReturnType<typeof page.getByTestId>) => {
    let prev = await loc.boundingBox();
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      await page.waitForTimeout(40);
      const cur = await loc.boundingBox();
      if (prev && cur && Math.abs(cur.x - prev.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(cur.y - prev.y) < 0.5 && Math.abs(cur.height - prev.height) < 0.5) return cur;
      prev = cur;
    }
    return prev!;
  };
  /** tap a testID (string) or any locator, e.g. page.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Female' }) */
  const tap = async (id: string | ReturnType<typeof page.getByRole>) => {
    const loc = typeof id === 'string' ? page.getByTestId(id) : id;
    const b = await stableBox(loc.first());
    taps.push({ t: Date.now() / 1000, x: b.x + b.width / 2, y: b.y + b.height / 2 });
    await loc.first().click();
  };
  /** tap a text field and type into it like a person (visible typing) */
  const type = async (id: string, text: string) => {
    await tap(id);
    await page.getByTestId(id).pressSequentially(text, { delay: 26 });
  };
  /** open a dropdown/sheet by testID and choose an option (radio) by its label */
  const pick = async (trigger: string, option: string) => {
    await tap(trigger);
    await tap(page.getByRole('radio', { name: option }));
    await page.waitForTimeout(110);
  };
  /** smooth scroll so the element is centred (a jump looks bad in the video). Wait ~1.4 s after a long scroll. */
  const scrollTo = (id: string) => page.evaluate((tid) => document.querySelector(`[data-testid="${tid}"]`)!.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' }), id);
  const smoothTo = async (id: string) => {
    await scrollTo(id);
    await page.waitForTimeout(450);
  };

  // ═════════════════════ FLOW: replace from here to the "end" mark ═════════════════════
  // Scene 2 of config.json: Home -> Manage -> Add Staff. The tap is narrated `at` seconds after the scene starts (config.json), so pace the recording about the same; the render re-times small differences.
  mark('s2_start');
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  await scrollTo('manage-add-staff'); // scroll down to the Manage cards (~1.4 s)
  await page.waitForTimeout(2400);
  mark('s2_tap');
  await tap('manage-add-staff');
  await page.waitForURL(/\/admin\/staff\/edit/);
  await expect(page.getByTestId('staff-name')).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);

  // Scene 3: fill the form
  mark('s3_start');
  await type('staff-name', 'Priya Sharma');
  await type('staff-phone', '9876543210');
  await type('staff-email', 'priya@acme.in');
  await smoothTo('staff-branch'); // the Assignment fields are below the fold
  await pick('staff-branch', BRANCHES.hq.name);
  await pick('staff-dept', DEPARTMENTS.sales.name);
  await pick('staff-gender', 'Female');
  mark('s3_end');

  // Scene 4: submit (leave a calm 1.9 s so the finger can travel to the button while the form rests, then tap)
  await page.waitForTimeout(1900);
  mark('s4_tap');
  await tap('staff-submit');
  await page.waitForURL(/\/admin\/home/);
  await expect(page.getByText('Staff added successfully!').first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(3700); // hold the result on screen
  mark('s4_end');
  // ═════════════════════ end of FLOW ═════════════════════

  await cdp.send('Page.stopScreencast');
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  fs.writeFileSync(`${OUT}/live.json`, JSON.stringify({ frames, taps, marks, viewport: page.viewportSize()!, dpr: 3 }));
  console.log(`RECORDED ${frames.length} frames; ${taps.length} taps; marks ${JSON.stringify(marks)}`);
});
